1.shows: A dim, wood-panelled listening bar. A long bar with tall stools and record shelves runs down the left, small round tables with glowing globe lamps line a padded bench on the right, a sphere of coloured neon rings hangs from the ceiling, and a pair of large speakers stands against the far wall.
